# Krylov-FSP-SSA vs AdaptiveFSP Comparison
# For reviewer response: demonstrates flux-aware pruning advantages
#
# Tier 1: Oregonator — full quantitative comparison
# Tier 2: Bottleneck — connectivity failure diagnostic
# Tier 3: Robertson — stiffness failure diagnostic

using DiscStochSim, Catalyst, Random, Printf
using Plots

gr()
default(
    fontfamily="Computer Modern",
    titlefontsize=14,
    guidefontsize=12,
    tickfontsize=10,
    legendfontsize=9,
    linewidth=2,
    framestyle=:box,
    grid=false,
    dpi=300,
)

const OUTDIR = joinpath(@__DIR__, "output", "comparison")
mkpath(OUTDIR)

# ============================================================================
# Tier 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison
# ============================================================================
function run_oregonator_comparison()
    println("=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        @species X(t) Y(t) Z(t)
        @parameters k1 k2 k3 k4 k5
        k1, Y --> X
        k2, X + Y --> 0
        k3, X --> 2X + Z
        k4, 2X --> 0
        k5, Z --> Y
    end

    y1s, y2s, y3s = 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0
    mu1s, mu2s = 2000.0, 50000.0
    rates = [
        mu1s / y2s,
        mu2s / (y1s * y2s),
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y1s,
        2 * mu1s / y1s^2,
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y3s,
    ]

    tfinal = 0.11
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(500, 1000, 2000), (0.0, tfinal), rates;
                      bounds=(0, 50_000))

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.1, flux_tolerance=1.0,
        expansion_depth=1, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)

    # Run KrylovFSP
    # τ_init=1e-6 is accepted without halving; max_iter=10000 caps at ~t=0.01
    # This demonstrates that KrylovFSP needs ~10x more iterations for partial coverage
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=10000)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=1e-6, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=1000, max_iter=10000,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Oregonator Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Final |S|",
            sol_afsp.state_space_sizes[end], sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Max |S|",
            maximum(sol_afsp.state_space_sizes), maximum(sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP rejections", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP total iters", diag_kfsp.total_iters))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean trajectories overlaid
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean trajectories", xlabel="Time", ylabel="Population")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 1], label="X (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="Y (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="Z (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:solid)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 1], label="X (KrylovFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="Y (KrylovFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="Z (KrylovFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (b) State space size over time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (c) dt/τ over time
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Time step size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="dt / τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(sol_afsp.t) > 1
        dt_afsp = diff(sol_afsp.t)
        plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t[2:end], dt_afsp, label="AdaptiveFSP dt", color=:blue)
    end
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, diag_kfsp.time_log, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) Marginal distribution at final time
    p4 = plot(title="(d) Marginal P(X) at t_f", xlabel="X", ylabel="Probability")
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        m_afsp = marginal(sol_afsp, length(sol_afsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_afsp.values, m_afsp.probs, label="AdaptiveFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:blue)
    end
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        m_kfsp = marginal(sol_kfsp, length(sol_kfsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_kfsp.values, m_kfsp.probs, label="KrylovFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:red)

    println("Saved oregonator_comparison.{png,pdf}")

            t_afsp=t_afsp, t_kfsp=t_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
# Tier 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic
# ============================================================================
function run_bottleneck_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, B --> B + C
    end

    rates = [1e-6, 1e-1]
    bounds = (0, Int(1e11))
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(1, 0, 0), (0.0, 1e5), rates; bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP (full, as reference)
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (reference)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.9, flux_tolerance=1e-6, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP (capped iterations — diagnostic)
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=500, diagnostic)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-4, τ_init=1e3, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=100, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Check if B=1 state was lost in KrylovFSP
    bottleneck_state = CartesianIndex(0, 1, 0)
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        final_states_kfsp = sol_kfsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_kfsp)
        println("  KrylovFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck")
    end

    # Check bottleneck presence in AdaptiveFSP
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        final_states_afsp = sol_afsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck_afsp = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_afsp)
        println("  AdaptiveFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck_afsp")
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Bottleneck Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    t_reached_afsp = sol_afsp.t[end]
    t_reached_kfsp = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", t_reached_afsp, t_reached_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <A>", traj_afsp[end, 1], traj_kfsp[end, 1]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <B>", traj_afsp[end, 2], traj_kfsp[end, 2]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <C>", traj_afsp[end, 3], traj_kfsp[end, 3]))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean of C over time
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean C trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<C>")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Mean of B over time (shows bottleneck loss)
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Mean B trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<B>")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (c) State space size
    p3 = plot(title="(c) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p3, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) KrylovFSP diagnostics: τ and mass over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) KrylovFSP diagnostics", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Value")
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        iters = 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log)
        plot!(p4, iters, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="τ", color=:blue, yscale=:log10)
        plot!(twinx(p4), iters, diag_kfsp.mass_log, label="mass", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, ylabel="Mass", legend=:bottomright)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved bottleneck_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
# Tier 3: Robertson — Stiffness Failure Diagnostic
# ============================================================================
function run_robertson_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 3: Robertson — Stiffness Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, 2B --> C + B
        k3, C + B --> A + C
    end

    rates = [0.04, 3e6, 1.0]
    bounds = (0, 100_001)
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(10_000, 0, 0), (0.0, 1e4), rates;
                      bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=0.01, prob_quantile=0.4, flux_tolerance=1e-9, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP (capped — diagnostic)
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=200, diagnostic)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-4, τ_init=0.1, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=50, max_iter=200,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Compute extrapolated completion time
    t_reached = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    tf = 1e4
    if t_reached > 0 && t_kfsp > 0
        extrapolated = t_kfsp * (tf / t_reached)
    else
        extrapolated = Inf
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Robertson Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Total iterations", length(sol_afsp.t)-1, diag_kfsp.total_iters))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", sol_afsp.t[end], t_reached))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15d", "Rejections", "N/A", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15.2e", "Final τ", "N/A", diag_kfsp.τ_log[end]))
    end
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15.2e", "Extrapolated completion (s)", "---", extrapolated))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) τ vs iteration (shows halving cascade)
    p1 = plot(title="(a) τ vs iteration", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p1, 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log), diag_kfsp.τ_log,
              label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Simulated time reached vs wall time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Simulated time vs wall time",
              xlabel="Wall time (s)", ylabel="Simulated time")
    if length(diag_kfsp.walltime_log) > 0
        plot!(p2, diag_kfsp.walltime_log, diag_kfsp.time_log,
              label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end
    # Show AdaptiveFSP final point for reference
    scatter!(p2, [t_afsp], [sol_afsp.t[end]], label="AdaptiveFSP (complete)",
             color=:blue, markersize=8, markershape=:star5)

    # (c) Mass conservation over iterations
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Probability mass", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Mass")
    if length(diag_kfsp.mass_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, 1:length(diag_kfsp.mass_log), diag_kfsp.mass_log,
              label="KrylovFSP mass", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (d) State space size over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) State space size", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="|S|")
    if length(diag_kfsp.size_log) > 0
        plot!(p4, 1:length(diag_kfsp.size_log), diag_kfsp.size_log,
              label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved robertson_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

# Krylov-FSP-SSA vs AdaptiveFSP Comparison
# For reviewer response: demonstrates flux-aware pruning advantages
#
# Tier 1: Oregonator — full quantitative comparison
# Tier 2: Bottleneck — connectivity failure diagnostic
# Tier 3: Robertson — stiffness failure diagnostic

using DiscStochSim, Catalyst, Random, Printf
using Plots

gr()
default(
    fontfamily="Computer Modern",
    titlefontsize=14,
    guidefontsize=12,
    tickfontsize=10,
    legendfontsize=9,
    linewidth=2,
    framestyle=:box,
    grid=false,
    dpi=300,
)

const OUTDIR = joinpath(@__DIR__, "output", "comparison")
mkpath(OUTDIR)

# ============================================================================
# Tier 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison
# ============================================================================
function run_oregonator_comparison()
    println("=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        @species X(t) Y(t) Z(t)
        @parameters k1 k2 k3 k4 k5
        k1, Y --> X
        k2, X + Y --> 0
        k3, X --> 2X + Z
        k4, 2X --> 0
        k5, Z --> Y
    end

    y1s, y2s, y3s = 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0
    mu1s, mu2s = 2000.0, 50000.0
    rates = [
        mu1s / y2s,
        mu2s / (y1s * y2s),
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y1s,
        2 * mu1s / y1s^2,
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y3s,
    ]

    tfinal = 0.11
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(500, 1000, 2000), (0.0, tfinal), rates;
                      bounds=(0, 50_000))

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.1, flux_tolerance=1.0,
        expansion_depth=1, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)

    # Run KrylovFSP
    # τ_init=1e-6 is accepted without halving; max_iter=10000 caps at ~t=0.01
    # This demonstrates that KrylovFSP needs ~10x more iterations for partial coverage
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=10000)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=1e-6, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=1000, max_iter=10000,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Oregonator Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Final |S|",
            sol_afsp.state_space_sizes[end], sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Max |S|",
            maximum(sol_afsp.state_space_sizes), maximum(sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Time reached",
            sol_afsp.t[end], sol_kfsp.t[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP rejections", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP total iters", diag_kfsp.total_iters))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean trajectories overlaid
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean trajectories", xlabel="Time", ylabel="Population")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 1], label="X (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="Y (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="Z (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:solid)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 1], label="X (KrylovFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="Y (KrylovFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="Z (KrylovFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (b) State space size over time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (c) dt/τ over time
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Time step size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="dt / τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(sol_afsp.t) > 1
        dt_afsp = diff(sol_afsp.t)
        plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t[2:end], dt_afsp, label="AdaptiveFSP dt", color=:blue)
    end
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, diag_kfsp.time_log, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) Marginal distribution at final time
    p4 = plot(title="(d) Marginal P(X) at t_f", xlabel="X", ylabel="Probability")
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        m_afsp = marginal(sol_afsp, length(sol_afsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_afsp.values, m_afsp.probs, label="AdaptiveFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:blue)
    end
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        m_kfsp = marginal(sol_kfsp, length(sol_kfsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_kfsp.values, m_kfsp.probs, label="KrylovFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:red)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved oregonator_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp,
            t_afsp=t_afsp, t_kfsp=t_kfsp)
end

# Tier 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic

function run_bottleneck_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, B --> B + C
    end

    rates = [1e-6, 1e-1]
    bounds = (0, Int(1e11))
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(1, 0, 0), (0.0, 1e5), rates; bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP (full, as reference)
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (reference)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.9, flux_tolerance=1e-6, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP (capped iterations — diagnostic)
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=500, diagnostic)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-4, τ_init=1e3, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=100, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Check if B=1 state was lost in KrylovFSP
    bottleneck_state = CartesianIndex(0, 1, 0)
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        final_states_kfsp = sol_kfsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_kfsp)
        println("  KrylovFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck")
    end

    # Check bottleneck presence in AdaptiveFSP
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        final_states_afsp = sol_afsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck_afsp = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_afsp)
        println("  AdaptiveFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck_afsp")
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Bottleneck Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    t_reached_afsp = sol_afsp.t[end]
    t_reached_kfsp = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", t_reached_afsp, t_reached_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <A>", traj_afsp[end, 1], traj_kfsp[end, 1]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <B>", traj_afsp[end, 2], traj_kfsp[end, 2]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <C>", traj_afsp[end, 3], traj_kfsp[end, 3]))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean of C over time
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean C trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<C>")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Mean of B over time (shows bottleneck loss)
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Mean B trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<B>")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (c) State space size
    p3 = plot(title="(c) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p3, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) KrylovFSP diagnostics: τ and mass over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) KrylovFSP diagnostics", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Value")
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        iters = 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log)
        plot!(p4, iters, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="τ", color=:blue, yscale=:log10)
        plot!(twinx(p4), iters, diag_kfsp.mass_log, label="mass", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, ylabel="Mass", legend=:bottomright)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved bottleneck_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

    end

    if length(diag_kfsp.size_log) > 0

    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.pdf"))

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)

# Krylov-FSP-SSA vs AdaptiveFSP Comparison
# For reviewer response: demonstrates flux-aware pruning advantages
#
# Tier 1: Oregonator — full quantitative comparison
# Tier 2: Bottleneck — connectivity failure diagnostic
# Tier 3: Robertson — stiffness failure diagnostic

using DiscStochSim, Catalyst, Random, Printf
using Plots

gr()
default(
    fontfamily="Computer Modern",
    titlefontsize=14,
    guidefontsize=12,
    tickfontsize=10,
    legendfontsize=9,
    linewidth=2,
    framestyle=:box,
    grid=false,
    dpi=300,
)

const OUTDIR = joinpath(@__DIR__, "output", "comparison")
mkpath(OUTDIR)

# ============================================================================
# Tier 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison
# ============================================================================
function run_oregonator_comparison()
    println("=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        @species X(t) Y(t) Z(t)
        @parameters k1 k2 k3 k4 k5
        k1, Y --> X
        k2, X + Y --> 0
        k3, X --> 2X + Z
        k4, 2X --> 0
        k5, Z --> Y
    end

    y1s, y2s, y3s = 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0
    mu1s, mu2s = 2000.0, 50000.0
    rates = [
        mu1s / y2s,
        mu2s / (y1s * y2s),
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y1s,
        2 * mu1s / y1s^2,
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y3s,
    ]

    tfinal = 0.11
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(500, 1000, 2000), (0.0, tfinal), rates;
                      bounds=(0, 50_000))

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.1, flux_tolerance=1.0,
        expansion_depth=1, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)

    # Run KrylovFSP
    # τ_init=1e-6 is accepted without halving; max_iter=10000 caps at ~t=0.01
    # This demonstrates that KrylovFSP needs ~10x more iterations for partial coverage
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=10000)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=1e-6, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=1000, max_iter=10000,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Oregonator Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Final |S|",
            sol_afsp.state_space_sizes[end], sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Max |S|",
            maximum(sol_afsp.state_space_sizes), maximum(sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Time reached",
            sol_afsp.t[end], sol_kfsp.t[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP rejections", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP total iters", diag_kfsp.total_iters))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean trajectories overlaid
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean trajectories", xlabel="Time", ylabel="Population")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 1], label="X (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="Y (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="Z (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:solid)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 1], label="X (KrylovFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="Y (KrylovFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="Z (KrylovFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (b) State space size over time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (c) dt/τ over time
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Time step size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="dt / τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(sol_afsp.t) > 1
        dt_afsp = diff(sol_afsp.t)
        plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t[2:end], dt_afsp, label="AdaptiveFSP dt", color=:blue)
    end
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, diag_kfsp.time_log, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) Marginal distribution at final time
    p4 = plot(title="(d) Marginal P(X) at t_f", xlabel="X", ylabel="Probability")
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        m_afsp = marginal(sol_afsp, length(sol_afsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_afsp.values, m_afsp.probs, label="AdaptiveFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:blue)
    end
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        m_kfsp = marginal(sol_kfsp, length(sol_kfsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_kfsp.values, m_kfsp.probs, label="KrylovFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:red)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved oregonator_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp,
            t_afsp=t_afsp, t_kfsp=t_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
# Tier 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic
# ============================================================================
function run_bottleneck_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, B --> B + C
    end

    rates = [1e-6, 1e-1]
    bounds = (0, Int(1e11))
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(1, 0, 0), (0.0, 1e5), rates; bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP (full, as reference)
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (reference)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.9, flux_tolerance=1e-6, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP (capped iterations — diagnostic)
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=500, diagnostic)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-4, τ_init=1e3, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=100, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Check if B=1 state was lost in KrylovFSP
    bottleneck_state = CartesianIndex(0, 1, 0)
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        final_states_kfsp = sol_kfsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_kfsp)
        println("  KrylovFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck")
    end

    # Check bottleneck presence in AdaptiveFSP
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        final_states_afsp = sol_afsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck_afsp = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_afsp)
        println("  AdaptiveFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck_afsp")
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Bottleneck Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    t_reached_afsp = sol_afsp.t[end]
    t_reached_kfsp = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", t_reached_afsp, t_reached_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <A>", traj_afsp[end, 1], traj_kfsp[end, 1]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <B>", traj_afsp[end, 2], traj_kfsp[end, 2]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <C>", traj_afsp[end, 3], traj_kfsp[end, 3]))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean of C over time
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean C trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<C>")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Mean of B over time (shows bottleneck loss)
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Mean B trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<B>")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (c) State space size
    p3 = plot(title="(c) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p3, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) KrylovFSP diagnostics: τ and mass over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) KrylovFSP diagnostics", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Value")
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        iters = 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log)
        plot!(p4, iters, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="τ", color=:blue, yscale=:log10)
        plot!(twinx(p4), iters, diag_kfsp.mass_log, label="mass", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, ylabel="Mass", legend=:bottomright)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved bottleneck_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
# Tier 3: Robertson — Stiffness Failure Diagnostic
# ============================================================================
function run_robertson_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 3: Robertson — Stiffness Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, 2B --> C + B
        k3, C + B --> A + C
    end

    rates = [0.04, 3e6, 1.0]
    bounds = (0, 100_001)
    tf = 1.0  # Short horizon; both methods can complete in reasonable time
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(10_000, 0, 0), (0.0, tf), rates;
                      bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (tf=$tf)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=0.01, prob_quantile=0.4, flux_tolerance=1e-9, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP (capped — diagnostic)
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=500, diagnostic)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=0.1, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=50, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)

    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Total iterations", length(sol_afsp.t)-1, diag_kfsp.total_iters))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", sol_afsp.t[end], t_reached))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15d", "Rejections", "N/A", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15.2e", "Final τ", "N/A", diag_kfsp.τ_log[end]))
    end
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15.2e", "Extrapolated completion (s)", "---", extrapolated))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) τ vs iteration (shows halving cascade)
    p1 = plot(title="(a) τ vs iteration", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p1, 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log), diag_kfsp.τ_log,
              label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Simulated time reached vs wall time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Simulated time vs wall time",
              xlabel="Wall time (s)", ylabel="Simulated time")
    if length(diag_kfsp.walltime_log) > 0
        plot!(p2, diag_kfsp.walltime_log, diag_kfsp.time_log,
              label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end
    # Show AdaptiveFSP final point for reference
    scatter!(p2, [t_afsp], [sol_afsp.t[end]], label="AdaptiveFSP (complete)",
             color=:blue, markersize=8, markershape=:star5)

    # (c) Mass conservation over iterations
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Probability mass", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Mass")
    if length(diag_kfsp.mass_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, 1:length(diag_kfsp.mass_log), diag_kfsp.mass_log,
              label="KrylovFSP mass", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (d) State space size over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) State space size", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="|S|")
    if length(diag_kfsp.size_log) > 0
        plot!(p4, 1:length(diag_kfsp.size_log), diag_kfsp.size_log,
              label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved robertson_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

# Krylov-FSP-SSA vs AdaptiveFSP Comparison
# For reviewer response: demonstrates flux-aware pruning advantages
#
# Tier 1: Oregonator — full quantitative comparison
# Tier 2: Bottleneck — connectivity failure diagnostic
# Tier 3: Robertson — stiffness failure diagnostic

using DiscStochSim, Catalyst, Random, Printf
using Plots

gr()
default(
    fontfamily="Computer Modern",
    titlefontsize=14,
    guidefontsize=12,
    tickfontsize=10,
    legendfontsize=9,
    linewidth=2,
    framestyle=:box,
    grid=false,
    dpi=300,
)

const OUTDIR = joinpath(@__DIR__, "output", "comparison")
mkpath(OUTDIR)

# ============================================================================
# Tier 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison
# ============================================================================
function run_oregonator_comparison()
    println("=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        @species X(t) Y(t) Z(t)
        @parameters k1 k2 k3 k4 k5
        k1, Y --> X
        k2, X + Y --> 0
        k3, X --> 2X + Z
        k4, 2X --> 0
        k5, Z --> Y
    end

    y1s, y2s, y3s = 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0
    mu1s, mu2s = 2000.0, 50000.0
    rates = [
        mu1s / y2s,
        mu2s / (y1s * y2s),
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y1s,
        2 * mu1s / y1s^2,
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y3s,
    ]

    tfinal = 0.11
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(500, 1000, 2000), (0.0, tfinal), rates;
                      bounds=(0, 50_000))

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.1, flux_tolerance=1.0,
        expansion_depth=1, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)

    # Run KrylovFSP
    # τ_init=1e-6 is accepted without halving; max_iter=10000 caps at ~t=0.01
    # This demonstrates that KrylovFSP needs ~10x more iterations for partial coverage
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=10000)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=1e-6, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=1000, max_iter=10000,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Oregonator Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Final |S|",
            sol_afsp.state_space_sizes[end], sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Max |S|",
            maximum(sol_afsp.state_space_sizes), maximum(sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Time reached",
            sol_afsp.t[end], sol_kfsp.t[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP rejections", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP total iters", diag_kfsp.total_iters))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean trajectories overlaid
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean trajectories", xlabel="Time", ylabel="Population")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 1], label="X (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="Y (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="Z (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:solid)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 1], label="X (KrylovFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="Y (KrylovFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="Z (KrylovFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (b) State space size over time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (c) dt/τ over time
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Time step size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="dt / τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(sol_afsp.t) > 1
        dt_afsp = diff(sol_afsp.t)
        plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t[2:end], dt_afsp, label="AdaptiveFSP dt", color=:blue)
    end
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, diag_kfsp.time_log, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) Marginal distribution at final time
    p4 = plot(title="(d) Marginal P(X) at t_f", xlabel="X", ylabel="Probability")
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        m_afsp = marginal(sol_afsp, length(sol_afsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_afsp.values, m_afsp.probs, label="AdaptiveFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:blue)
    end
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        m_kfsp = marginal(sol_kfsp, length(sol_kfsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_kfsp.values, m_kfsp.probs, label="KrylovFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:red)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved oregonator_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp,
            t_afsp=t_afsp, t_kfsp=t_kfsp)
end

# Tier 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic
# ============================================================================
function run_bottleneck_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, B --> B + C
    end

    rates = [1e-6, 1e-1]
    bounds = (0, Int(1e11))
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(1, 0, 0), (0.0, 1e5), rates; bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP (full, as reference)
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (reference)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.9, flux_tolerance=1e-6, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP (capped iterations — diagnostic)
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=500, diagnostic)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-4, τ_init=1e3, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=100, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Check if B=1 state was lost in KrylovFSP
    bottleneck_state = CartesianIndex(0, 1, 0)
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        final_states_kfsp = sol_kfsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_kfsp)
        println("  KrylovFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck")
    end

    # Check bottleneck presence in AdaptiveFSP
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        final_states_afsp = sol_afsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck_afsp = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_afsp)
        println("  AdaptiveFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck_afsp")
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Bottleneck Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    t_reached_afsp = sol_afsp.t[end]
    t_reached_kfsp = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", t_reached_afsp, t_reached_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <A>", traj_afsp[end, 1], traj_kfsp[end, 1]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <B>", traj_afsp[end, 2], traj_kfsp[end, 2]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <C>", traj_afsp[end, 3], traj_kfsp[end, 3]))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean of C over time
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean C trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<C>")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Mean of B over time (shows bottleneck loss)
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Mean B trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<B>")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (c) State space size
    p3 = plot(title="(c) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p3, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) KrylovFSP diagnostics: τ and mass over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) KrylovFSP diagnostics", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Value")
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        iters = 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log)
        plot!(p4, iters, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="τ", color=:blue, yscale=:log10)
        plot!(twinx(p4), iters, diag_kfsp.mass_log, label="mass", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, ylabel="Mass", legend=:bottomright)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved bottleneck_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
# Tier 3: Robertson — Stiffness Failure Diagnostic
# ============================================================================
function run_robertson_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 3: Robertson — Stiffness Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, 2B --> C + B
        k3, C + B --> A + C
    end

    rates = [0.04, 3e6, 1.0]
    bounds = (0, 100_001)
    tf = 1.0  # Short horizon; both methods can complete in reasonable time
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(10_000, 0, 0), (0.0, tf), rates;
                      bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (tf=$tf)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=0.01, prob_quantile=0.4, flux_tolerance=1e-9, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP (capped — diagnostic)
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=500, diagnostic)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=0.1, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=50, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Compute extrapolated completion time
    t_reached = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    if t_reached > 0 && t_kfsp > 0
        extrapolated = t_kfsp * (tf / t_reached)
    else
        extrapolated = Inf
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Robertson Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Total iterations", length(sol_afsp.t)-1, diag_kfsp.total_iters))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", sol_afsp.t[end], t_reached))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15d", "Rejections", "N/A", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15.2e", "Final τ", "N/A", diag_kfsp.τ_log[end]))
    end
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15.2e", "Extrapolated completion (s)", "---", extrapolated))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) τ vs iteration (shows halving cascade)
    p1 = plot(title="(a) τ vs iteration", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p1, 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log), diag_kfsp.τ_log,
              label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Simulated time reached vs wall time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Simulated time vs wall time",
              xlabel="Wall time (s)", ylabel="Simulated time")
    if length(diag_kfsp.walltime_log) > 0
        plot!(p2, diag_kfsp.walltime_log, diag_kfsp.time_log,
              label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end
    # Show AdaptiveFSP final point for reference
    scatter!(p2, [t_afsp], [sol_afsp.t[end]], label="AdaptiveFSP (complete)",
             color=:blue, markersize=8, markershape=:star5)

    # (c) Mass conservation over iterations
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Probability mass", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Mass")
    if length(diag_kfsp.mass_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, 1:length(diag_kfsp.mass_log), diag_kfsp.mass_log,
              label="KrylovFSP mass", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (d) State space size over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) State space size", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="|S|")
    if length(diag_kfsp.size_log) > 0
        plot!(p4, 1:length(diag_kfsp.size_log), diag_kfsp.size_log,
              label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved robertson_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
# Tier 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison
# ============================================================================
function run_oregonator_comparison()
    println("=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        @species X(t) Y(t) Z(t)
        @parameters k1 k2 k3 k4 k5
        k1, Y --> X
        k2, X + Y --> 0
        k3, X --> 2X + Z
        k4, 2X --> 0
        k5, Z --> Y
    end

    y1s, y2s, y3s = 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0
    mu1s, mu2s = 2000.0, 50000.0
    rates = [
        mu1s / y2s,
        mu2s / (y1s * y2s),
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y1s,
        2 * mu1s / y1s^2,
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y3s,
    ]

    tfinal = 0.11
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(500, 1000, 2000), (0.0, tfinal), rates;
                      bounds=(0, 50_000))

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.1, flux_tolerance=1.0,
        expansion_depth=1, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)

    # Run KrylovFSP
    # τ_init=1e-6 is accepted without halving; max_iter=10000 caps at ~t=0.01
    # This demonstrates that KrylovFSP needs ~10x more iterations for partial coverage
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=10000)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=1e-6, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=1000, max_iter=10000,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Oregonator Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Final |S|",
            sol_afsp.state_space_sizes[end], sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Max |S|",
            maximum(sol_afsp.state_space_sizes), maximum(sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Time reached",
            sol_afsp.t[end], sol_kfsp.t[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP rejections", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP total iters", diag_kfsp.total_iters))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean trajectories overlaid
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean trajectories", xlabel="Time", ylabel="Population")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 1], label="X (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="Y (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="Z (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:solid)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 1], label="X (KrylovFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="Y (KrylovFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="Z (KrylovFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (b) State space size over time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (c) dt/τ over time
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Time step size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="dt / τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(sol_afsp.t) > 1
        dt_afsp = diff(sol_afsp.t)
        plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t[2:end], dt_afsp, label="AdaptiveFSP dt", color=:blue)
    end
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, diag_kfsp.time_log, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) Marginal distribution at final time
    p4 = plot(title="(d) Marginal P(X) at t_f", xlabel="X", ylabel="Probability")
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        m_afsp = marginal(sol_afsp, length(sol_afsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_afsp.values, m_afsp.probs, label="AdaptiveFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:blue)
    end
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        m_kfsp = marginal(sol_kfsp, length(sol_kfsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_kfsp.values, m_kfsp.probs, label="KrylovFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:red)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved oregonator_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp,
            t_afsp=t_afsp, t_kfsp=t_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
# Tier 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic
# ============================================================================
function run_bottleneck_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, B --> B + C
    end

    rates = [1e-6, 1e-1]
    bounds = (0, Int(1e11))
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(1, 0, 0), (0.0, 1e5), rates; bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP (full, as reference)
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (reference)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.9, flux_tolerance=1e-6, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP (capped iterations — diagnostic)
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=500, diagnostic)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-4, τ_init=1e3, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=100, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Check if B=1 state was lost in KrylovFSP
    bottleneck_state = CartesianIndex(0, 1, 0)
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        final_states_kfsp = sol_kfsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_kfsp)
        println("  KrylovFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck")
    end

    # Check bottleneck presence in AdaptiveFSP
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        final_states_afsp = sol_afsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck_afsp = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_afsp)
        println("  AdaptiveFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck_afsp")
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Bottleneck Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    t_reached_afsp = sol_afsp.t[end]
    t_reached_kfsp = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", t_reached_afsp, t_reached_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <A>", traj_afsp[end, 1], traj_kfsp[end, 1]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <B>", traj_afsp[end, 2], traj_kfsp[end, 2]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <C>", traj_afsp[end, 3], traj_kfsp[end, 3]))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean of C over time
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean C trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<C>")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Mean of B over time (shows bottleneck loss)
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Mean B trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<B>")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (c) State space size
    p3 = plot(title="(c) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p3, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) KrylovFSP diagnostics: τ and mass over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) KrylovFSP diagnostics", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Value")
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        iters = 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log)
        plot!(p4, iters, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="τ", color=:blue, yscale=:log10)
        plot!(twinx(p4), iters, diag_kfsp.mass_log, label="mass", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, ylabel="Mass", legend=:bottomright)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "bottleneck_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved bottleneck_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
# Tier 3: Robertson — Stiffness Failure Diagnostic
# ============================================================================
function run_robertson_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 3: Robertson — Stiffness Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, 2B --> C + B
        k3, C + B --> A + C
    end

    rates = [0.04, 3e6, 1.0]
    bounds = (0, 100_001)
    tf = 10.0  # Both methods complete; shows stiffness handling differences
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(10_000, 0, 0), (0.0, tf), rates;
                      bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (tf=$tf)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=0.01, prob_quantile=0.4, flux_tolerance=1e-9, save_interval=5000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=0.1, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=50, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Compute extrapolated completion time
    t_reached = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    if t_reached > 0 && t_kfsp > 0
        extrapolated = t_kfsp * (tf / t_reached)
    else
        extrapolated = Inf
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Robertson Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Total iterations", length(sol_afsp.t)-1, diag_kfsp.total_iters))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", sol_afsp.t[end], t_reached))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15d", "Rejections", "N/A", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15.2e", "Final τ", "N/A", diag_kfsp.τ_log[end]))
    end
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15.2e", "Extrapolated completion (s)", "---", extrapolated))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) τ vs iteration (shows halving cascade)
    p1 = plot(title="(a) τ vs iteration", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p1, 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log), diag_kfsp.τ_log,
              label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Simulated time reached vs wall time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Simulated time vs wall time",
              xlabel="Wall time (s)", ylabel="Simulated time")
    if length(diag_kfsp.walltime_log) > 0
        plot!(p2, diag_kfsp.walltime_log, diag_kfsp.time_log,
              label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end
    # Show AdaptiveFSP final point for reference
    scatter!(p2, [t_afsp], [sol_afsp.t[end]], label="AdaptiveFSP (complete)",
             color=:blue, markersize=8, markershape=:star5)

    # (c) Mass conservation over iterations
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Probability mass", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Mass")
    if length(diag_kfsp.mass_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, 1:length(diag_kfsp.mass_log), diag_kfsp.mass_log,
              label="KrylovFSP mass", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (d) State space size over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) State space size", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="|S|")
    if length(diag_kfsp.size_log) > 0
        plot!(p4, 1:length(diag_kfsp.size_log), diag_kfsp.size_log,
              label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linewidth=2)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "robertson_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved robertson_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end

# Krylov-FSP-SSA vs AdaptiveFSP Comparison
# For reviewer response: demonstrates flux-aware pruning advantages
#
# Tier 1: Oregonator — full quantitative comparison
# Tier 2: Bottleneck — connectivity failure diagnostic
# Tier 3: Robertson — stiffness failure diagnostic

gr()

# ============================================================================
# Tier 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison
# ============================================================================
function run_oregonator_comparison()
    println("=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 1: Oregonator — Full Quantitative Comparison")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        @species X(t) Y(t) Z(t)
        @parameters k1 k2 k3 k4 k5
        k1, Y --> X
        k2, X + Y --> 0
        k3, X --> 2X + Z
        k4, 2X --> 0
        k5, Z --> Y
    end

    y1s, y2s, y3s = 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0
    mu1s, mu2s = 2000.0, 50000.0
    rates = [
        mu1s / y2s,
        mu2s / (y1s * y2s),
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y1s,
        2 * mu1s / y1s^2,
        (mu1s + mu2s) / y3s,
    ]

    tfinal = 0.11
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(500, 1000, 2000), (0.0, tfinal), rates;
                      bounds=(0, 50_000))

    # Run AdaptiveFSP
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1.0, prob_quantile=0.1, flux_tolerance=1.0,
        expansion_depth=1, save_interval=1000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)

    # Run KrylovFSP
    # τ_init=1e-6 is accepted without halving; max_iter=10000 caps at ~t=0.01
    # This demonstrates that KrylovFSP needs ~10x more iterations for partial coverage
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=10000)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-2, τ_init=1e-6, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=1000, max_iter=10000,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Oregonator Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Final |S|",
            sol_afsp.state_space_sizes[end], sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d  %15d", "Max |S|",
            maximum(sol_afsp.state_space_sizes), maximum(sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes)))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Time reached",
            sol_afsp.t[end], sol_kfsp.t[end]))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP rejections", diag_kfsp.reject_count))
    println(@sprintf("%-25s  %15d", "KrylovFSP total iters", diag_kfsp.total_iters))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean trajectories overlaid
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean trajectories", xlabel="Time", ylabel="Population")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 1], label="X (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="Y (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:solid)
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="Z (AdaptiveFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:solid)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 1], label="X (KrylovFSP)", color=:blue, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="Y (KrylovFSP)", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="Z (KrylovFSP)", color=:green, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (b) State space size over time
    p2 = plot(title="(b) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (c) dt/τ over time
    p3 = plot(title="(c) Time step size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="dt / τ", yscale=:log10)
    if length(sol_afsp.t) > 1
        dt_afsp = diff(sol_afsp.t)
        plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t[2:end], dt_afsp, label="AdaptiveFSP dt", color=:blue)
    end
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        plot!(p3, diag_kfsp.time_log, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="KrylovFSP τ", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) Marginal distribution at final time
    p4 = plot(title="(d) Marginal P(X) at t_f", xlabel="X", ylabel="Probability")
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        m_afsp = marginal(sol_afsp, length(sol_afsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_afsp.values, m_afsp.probs, label="AdaptiveFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:blue)
    end
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        m_kfsp = marginal(sol_kfsp, length(sol_kfsp), 1)
        bar!(p4, m_kfsp.values, m_kfsp.probs, label="KrylovFSP", alpha=0.5, color=:red)
    end

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.png"))
    savefig(fig, joinpath(OUTDIR, "oregonator_comparison.pdf"))
    println("Saved oregonator_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp,
            t_afsp=t_afsp, t_kfsp=t_kfsp)
end

# ============================================================================
function run_bottleneck_comparison()
    println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
    println("TIER 2: Bottleneck — Connectivity Failure Diagnostic")
    println("=" ^ 60)

    rn = @reaction_network begin
        k1, A --> B
        k2, B --> B + C
    end

    rates = [1e-6, 1e-1]
    bounds = (0, Int(1e11))
    prob = FSPProblem(rn, CartesianIndex(1, 0, 0), (0.0, 1e5), rates; bounds=bounds)

    # Run AdaptiveFSP (full, as reference)
    # ε_dt=1e-6 gives dt ≈ 1s for propensity ~1e-6, ensuring fine temporal resolution
    println("\nRunning AdaptiveFSP (reference)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_afsp_start = time()
    sol_afsp = solve(prob, AdaptiveFSP(
        ε_dt=1e-6, prob_quantile=0.9, flux_tolerance=1e-6, save_interval=10000,
    ))
    t_afsp = time() - t_afsp_start
    traj_afsp = mean_trajectory(sol_afsp)
    println("  AdaptiveFSP: $(length(sol_afsp)) snapshots, $(round(t_afsp; digits=1))s")

    # Run KrylovFSP
    println("\nRunning KrylovFSP (max_iter=500)...")
    Random.default_rng(1)
    t_kfsp_start = time()
    sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp = solve(prob, KrylovFSP(
        ε=1e-4, τ_init=1e3, ℓ=5, r=1, save_interval=100, max_iter=500,
    ))
    t_kfsp = time() - t_kfsp_start
    traj_kfsp = mean_trajectory(sol_kfsp)
    println("  KrylovFSP: $(diag_kfsp.total_iters) iters, $(diag_kfsp.reject_count) rejections")

    # Check if B=1 state was lost in KrylovFSP
    bottleneck_state = CartesianIndex(0, 1, 0)
    if length(sol_kfsp) > 0
        final_states_kfsp = sol_kfsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_kfsp)
        println("  KrylovFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck")
    end

    # Check bottleneck presence in AdaptiveFSP
    if length(sol_afsp) > 0
        final_states_afsp = sol_afsp.snapshots[end][1]
        has_bottleneck_afsp = any(s -> s[2] >= 1, final_states_afsp)
        println("  AdaptiveFSP has B>=1 state at end: $has_bottleneck_afsp")
    end

    # Print results table
    println("\n--- Bottleneck Results ---")
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15s  %15s", "", "AdaptiveFSP", "KrylovFSP"))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2f  %15.2f", "Wall time (s)", t_afsp, t_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15d  %15d", "Snapshots", length(sol_afsp), length(sol_kfsp)))
    t_reached_afsp = sol_afsp.t[end]
    t_reached_kfsp = sol_kfsp.t[end]
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.2e  %15.2e", "Time reached", t_reached_afsp, t_reached_kfsp))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <A>", traj_afsp[end, 1], traj_kfsp[end, 1]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <B>", traj_afsp[end, 2], traj_kfsp[end, 2]))
    println(@sprintf("%-30s  %15.4f  %15.4f", "Final <C>", traj_afsp[end, 3], traj_kfsp[end, 3]))

    # Generate plots
    # (a) Mean of C over time
    p1 = plot(title="(a) Mean C trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<C>")
    plot!(p1, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 3], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p1, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 3], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (b) Mean of B over time (shows bottleneck loss)
    p2 = plot(title="(b) Mean B trajectory", xlabel="Time", ylabel="<B>")
    plot!(p2, sol_afsp.t, traj_afsp[:, 2], label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue, linewidth=2)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p2, sol_kfsp.t, traj_kfsp[:, 2], label="KrylovFSP", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
    end

    # (c) State space size
    p3 = plot(title="(c) State space size", xlabel="Time", ylabel="|S|")
    plot!(p3, sol_afsp.t, sol_afsp.state_space_sizes, label="AdaptiveFSP", color=:blue)
    if length(sol_kfsp.t) > 1
        plot!(p3, sol_kfsp.t, sol_kfsp.state_space_sizes, label="KrylovFSP", color=:red, linestyle=:dash)
    end

    # (d) KrylovFSP diagnostics: τ and mass over iterations
    p4 = plot(title="(d) KrylovFSP diagnostics", xlabel="Iteration", ylabel="Value")
    if length(diag_kfsp.τ_log) > 0
        iters = 1:length(diag_kfsp.τ_log)
        plot!(p4, iters, diag_kfsp.τ_log, label="τ", color=:blue, yscale=:log10)
        plot!(twinx(p4), iters, diag_kfsp.mass_log, label="mass", color=:red,
              linestyle=:dash, ylabel="Mass", legend=:bottomright)

    fig = plot(p1, p2, p3, p4; layout=(2, 2), size=(1200, 800), margin=5Plots.mm)

    println("Saved bottleneck_comparison.{png,pdf}")

    return (sol_afsp=sol_afsp, sol_kfsp=sol_kfsp, diag_kfsp=diag_kfsp)
end
